description.value: Valhalla Smoke House is a family-friendly BBQ restaurant in Kamloops that evolved from a food truck started in 2020 into a full restaurant in 2024. They specialize in slow-smoked meats — including brisket, pulled pork, ribs, and chicken — alongside house-made sides and salads. The restaurant also runs a full catering operation and can host large group bookings, making it a solid stop for cycling groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms a BBQ restaurant at 1850 Mission Flats Road, Kamloops, operating from a brick-and-mortar location since 2024. The page title 'BBQ TakeOut Food Homemade' confirms takeout service, and the catering menu explicitly labels items as Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten Free, and Dairy Free. No cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both sourced from website only — contact_confirmed cannot be corroborated against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open BBQ restaurant in Kamloops with an active website and confirmed contact details; offers takeout and accommodates dietary restrictions.
